chapter.verse: Kote omna ahi leibuk in a siat leh, khut tawh kibawl lo Pasian’ bawlsa, a kisia ngei lo vantungah inn a om cih ka thei uh hi.
Kote in vantung pan a piang omna silh nadingin thuumin ka om uh hi.
Tua bang silh lehang puan nei loin om ding i hi kei ding hi.

Hih bukah a om kote in vangik pua-in thuumin ka tau uh hi. Puan silh loin om nuam ka hih manun a thuum ka hi kei uh hi; a si thei nuntakna in nuntakna sungah a phumcip dingin puan silhin om nuam ka hih manunah ka thuum uh hi.
Tua bang thupha ngah nading a hong bawlpa in Pasian ahi hi. Tua Pasian in hong tung ding hun ading Kha Siangtho ahi maleep eite hong pia zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin pumpi-ah ka om lai tengun Pasian tawh ka kigamla uh hi cih thei-in lau loin ka om uh hi.
Kote in mit’ muhna tawh hi loin, upna tawh ka nungta uh hi.
Pum leh tak tawh kikhenin Topa tawh innah omkhawm tawntung dingin ut zaw-in lau lohna lungsim ka nei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kote in pumpi sung ahi innah ka om uh hi taleh, pumpi tawh kikhenin ka om uh hi taleh, Pasian ka lungdamsak nading uh ngimna nei-in ka hahkat uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite khempeuh in pumpi-ah i gamtatna ahoih ahoih lo bangin thukhenna ngah ciat dingin Khazih’ tokhom mai-ah i tung tek ding hi.
Tua ahih leh, Topa kihtakna kote in thei-in midangte ka zol lai takun Pasian mai-ah ka kilang uh hi. Note lungsim mai-ah zong ka kilang uh hi ci-in ka um uh hi.

Kote in note mai-ah komau pumpi uh kiphat kik ka hi kei uh hi; lungsim ngaihsun loin, a meel ngaihsunin a kisathei mite’ kam na thukkik theih nadingun, kote hangah kisaktheih nading bek kong gen uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mihai hi le-ung Pasian ading ka hai uh hi. Mipil hi le-ung note ading mipil ka hi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khempeuh tang ding mi khat bek si ahih ciangin mi khempeuh a si uh ahi zongin,

a nungta mite in amau deih bang uh a hin’ loh uh a, amaute tang ding si-a a thokik pa’ deihna bang a hin’ nadingun mi khempeuh tangding sihna a thuak ci-in ahi zongin ka ciamteh uh a, Khazih hong itna in zawhthawhna tawh kote hong zol ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-a kipan kote in ci-le-sa pawlte ngaihsunin kuamah ka thei kei uh hi. Ci-le-sa pawlte ngaihsunin Khazih ka theih ngei uh hangin tu-a kipanin tua bang ka thei ngei nawn kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Khazih sungah a om mi in mithak a suak hi. Alui nate kikheel a, athak a piang zo hi.
Na khempeuh Pasian panin a piang hi. Pasian in Khazih hangin amah tawh hong kilemsak a, tua kilemna thu tawh kipawl nasepna za kote hong pia hi.
Tua thu in, Pasian in Khazih sungah om a, leitungmite’ mawhna ciamteh loin amah tawh kilemsak a, tua kilemsakna thu kote hong pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kote in Khazih tang ding sawltak ka hi uh hi. Note in Pasian tawh na kilem un ci-in Pasian in kote tungah hong hansuah mah bangin kote in zong Khazih tang ding kong thuum uh hi.
Pasian in mawhna a nei lo Khazih, eite tangding mawhna a suaksak hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in tua mi hangin Pasian’ dikna i suah theih nading ahi hi.
